# Stage-1 results (generated by `seas report`; do not edit by hand)

All energies are **modelled** from synthetic profiles in simulation. Security is **simulated capability eligibility**; no TEE executed. 30 paired seeds per configuration.

## Confirmatory hypotheses (preregistered, Holm over H1–H3)

| hypothesis | p (raw) | p (Holm) | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | 0.020 | 0.040 | supported |
| H2 | 1.000 | 1.000 | NOT supported |
| H3 | < 0.001 | 0.002 | supported |

### H1 (S1): energy superiority + miss-rate non-inferiority vs EFT

* Relative dynamic energy seas/EFT − 1: mean -0.61 % (95 % CI -1.11 … -0.09 %), Wilcoxon one-sided p = 0.020, r_rb = -0.43.
* Miss rate: seas 3.7 % vs EFT 7.8 %; mean paired difference -4.13 pp, one-sided 95 % upper bound -3.22 pp (bootstrap -3.27 pp) vs margin 2 pp; p_NI = < 0.001 (Wilcoxon sensitivity p = < 0.001).
* Ablation: seas vs EFT-slack -1.60 % (CI -1.86 … -1.35 %, p = < 0.001); EFT-slack vs EFT 1.00 % (CI 0.55 … 1.48 %).

### H2 (S4): gain vs secure-job fraction

| secure fraction | mean energy gain vs EFT % | 95 % CI |
|---|---|---|
| 0.0 | 1.44 | 1.04 … 1.83 |
| 0.2 | 1.14 | 0.67 … 1.59 |
| 0.4 | 0.94 | 0.40 … 1.47 |
| 0.6 | 0.50 | -0.03 … 0.99 |
| 0.8 | 0.17 | -0.53 … 0.87 |

Per-seed OLS slope: mean -1.58 pp per unit fraction (CI -2.36 … -0.75), Wilcoxon (greater) p = 1.000.

### H3 (S7): robustness to estimation error

| σ | energy seas vs EFT % (CI) | p | miss seas − greedy pp (CI) | p | miss seas − EFT pp |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.1 | -1.04 (-1.58 … -0.49) | 0.001 | -11.35 (-13.52 … -9.32) | < 0.001 | -4.12 |
| 0.25 | -1.01 (-1.52 … -0.45) | < 0.001 | -10.32 (-12.42 … -8.40) | < 0.001 | -3.97 |
| 0.5 | -0.77 (-1.35 … -0.09) | 0.003 | -10.32 (-12.47 … -8.30) | < 0.001 | -5.70 |

### H4 (S1, descriptive): are deadlines binding?

Energy-greedy minus seas miss rate: 11.50 pp (CI 9.43 … 13.75); criterion ≥ 5 pp → binding. Energy-greedy energy vs seas: -4.75 %.
